events.summary: Dominaria heals and elementals flourish as the land is reinfused with mana.
events.quote: Elementals flourished as Dominaria healed and new forms of life adapted to the land's reinfusion with mana.

events.summary: The Ota conquer the Bastion of Suns and take its light.
events.quote: Having conquered the Bastion of Suns, the Ota took its light for their own.

events.summary: Doyo scythes away his grain to clear sightlines against suspected boggarts.
events.quote: so he scythed away his grain to clear the sightlines.

events.summary: Tarox Bladewing hunts and devours each of his siblings.
events.quote: he finds and devours each in turn.

events.summary: The Creators make the world and learn there is no shortcut to work done well.
events.quote: The Creators learned this to their sorrow, the first time they made the world.
